name: @tellma/core-ui
description: Tellma UI component library — tm-* form controls built on @angular/cdk + @angular/aria, signal-first, Signal Forms native.

Raised from 5 to 8. About 1.1 KB is the foundation seams the app shell builds on: TmBreakpoints over five media query lists, TmTheme with its System tracking, the live root Directionality, the translations loader and the touch-size resolver. About 1.4 KB is the ICU MessageFormat interpreter that replaced the eval-based compiler, so messages format under a script-src 'self' Content Security Policy with no 'unsafe-eval'; the old compiler lived in an external @jsverse package outside this measurement, so the app bundle itself shrinks (it no longer carries @messageformat/core and its plural data). The instant and time-zone additions that headroom was kept for have landed: the display-zone, device-zone and clock tokens and the formatting facade's instant, zone-label, relative-time and name members took the measured weight from 7.18 to 7.79, leaving about 0.2 KB.
budgetNotes../l10n: Raised from 8 to 10 for instants and period formatting: measured 7.65 before and 9.50 after (+1.85 KB). The weight is the instant parser, the date-time, time and relative-time formatters with their zone arithmetic (offsets, calendar days in a zone, daylight-saving days), the zone offset and zone name labels and the label decision, the month, quarter, year and weekday date styles, month and weekday names, the grouping option, and the stripping of bidirectional control characters from every formatter's output. Kept down by one cached Intl formatter factory shared by every instant path and by the instant formats reusing the date engine's style table.
budgetNotes../popover: Raised from 4 to 4.5 for keeping open popovers inside the viewport: the width cap is written from the visible viewport width (100vw counted a classic scrollbar, so a clamped panel ran under it), and the height cap, width cap and inline offset are re-fitted on every scroll and resize while open (the CDK reports a placement only when its side changes). Measured 4087 B before these fixes and 4228 B after (+141 B net); the saving taken in the same change was folding the three fixed-size width rules into one custom property read by the base rule. The entry point holds the fixed sizes, the viewport fitting and the block cap.
budgetNotes../entity-picker: Raised from 11 to 12 for the in-field invalid glyph the picker now draws itself (the field can only append its own AFTER the whole control, which would shove the magnifier sideways every time an error came and went). Previously raised from 10 to 11. The picker measures ~10.5 KB as one eager surface: it is an editable combobox that also carries an async search lifecycle, a text/value resolution channel, three modal pages, and a grid cell-editor implementation. The remaining lever is deferring the popup into its own chunk (the date-picker's shape), which is a change to the mounting sequence this control's overlay placement and highlight protocol are sensitive to — not worth reopening for 0.5 KB. Revisit if the popup is extracted for other reasons.
budgetNotes../form-field: Raised from 4 to 5 for the validation popover: the field now anchors an overlay (the shared @tellma/core-ui/overlay helper plus a CdkConnectedOverlay in its template) instead of writing a message into a row. The weight is the overlay wiring, not the bubble — the bubble itself is one presentational component shared with the grid.
budgetNotes../icon: Raised from 2 to 3 at birth: measured 2.7. The spec's 2 was an estimate below the real logic: the registry and the icon-data guard (the allowed elements, the refused event-handler and link attributes, attribute-name and kebab-case name checks, and refusal messages that are the only diagnostic a developer gets), plus the draw path (the template cache, the clone, the unknown-name and refusal reporting). The component's duplicated decorator metadata costs about 0.1 of it. Nothing here grows with the number of icons: icon data is its importer's weight.
budgetNotes../kbd: Raised from 1 to 2.5 at birth: measured 2.4. The spec's 1 was an estimate below the real logic: about 1.6 is the key-combination parser (with its two grammar errors), the matcher (the US punctuation table, the three event.code fallbacks, the AltGr rule) and the three label writers, and about 0.75 is tm-kbd itself, of which the duplicated decorator metadata is about 0.1.
budgetNotes../grid: Raised from 38 to 38.5 for the left-to-right run around a number cell's text (formatted numbers no longer carry direction marks, so markup keeps a minus at the left of its digits in a right-to-left grid): measured 38909 B before and about 38995 B after (+85 B: one attribute binding and one view-model field, against 3 B of headroom); the touched lines held nothing to fold. Previously raised from 37 to 38 for the shared validation bubble (the cell error now renders the same component the form field does, so a cell error and a field error cannot drift apart). Previously raised from 36 to 37 for the typed-commit search rung (the editor's own search decides a commit before the column's label resolver is asked). NOTE the standing gap: spec 0004 set grid at 24 KB and the measured surface has never been near it — this ceiling has climbed 34 -> 35 -> 36 -> 37 -> 38 -> 38.5 across four specs, each time as a ratchet over measured reality. Worth a dedicated pass rather than another increment.
budgetNotes._: Ceilings are ratchets. Any raise belongs here with its reason; a raise with no note is a bug.
